basics.name: David (Jiachen) Weng
basics.label: Product Engineer & Creative Technologist
basics.summary: Product engineer and creative technologist building AI-native music and media tools. My work spans product strategy, full-stack development, AI-integrated workflows, and visual design. Co-Founder of OwO Network, LLC.

projects.name: OpenMusic Series
projects.description: Open-source, local-first music tools. OpenKara turns your owned library into a karaoke stage with on-device AI stem separation; OpenLoop is a local AI music generator, an open-source alternative to Suno.
highlights: Built with Tauri 2 + Rust + React, cross-platform desktop apps
OpenKara: on-device AI stem separation, synced lyrics with multi-language romanization, remote library support, AirPlay casting
OpenLoop: local AI music generation from text prompts and lyrics; agent-first CLI with NDJSON streaming for automation pipelines

projects.name: Agent-Friendly CLI Tools
projects.description: A suite of Go command-line tools for AI agent orchestration across LMS, research repositories, personal finance, and photo management.
highlights: Stable JSON output, predictable exit codes, and distinct stdout/stderr for reliable machine consumption
Safety gates on all mutation commands with read-only and dry-run modes
